title: indigo_mount_synscan: README describes X_MOUNT_USE_ENCODERS
description: Add the owner-approved sentence about X_MOUNT_USE_ENCODERS to indigo_drivers/mount_synscan/README.md (approved by the owner on 2026-11-22: 'ok, pridaj ju tam'). Text, verbatim: 'X_MOUNT_USE_ENCODERS switches the dual (axis) encoders of the motor controller on or off; the coordinates always come from the motor step counters. When an encoder is switched on, the controller corrects the step counter of that axis from the encoder (an AZ-GTi does it at once and only to the encoder's coarse grid of about 0.34°), so sync or plate-solve again after switching it on.' Documentation only: no driver change, no version bump, no test run. Follows ticket 9fbd00e2, which changed the property's behaviour.

outcome.summary: Diff master...HEAD touches only indigo_drivers/mount_synscan/README.md (+2 lines): the added line equals the owner-approved sentence byte for byte (programmatic comparison with the ticket text; UTF-8 degree sign C2 B0, LF, no CR, no trailing whitespace, git diff --check clean), followed by one blank line, placed as the last paragraph of '## Comments' before '## Testing'; the Testing records are unchanged. Content checked against indigo_mount_synscan.driver and PROPERTIES.md: synscan_set_encoders only sends :W..04/:W..05 (on/off per axis); synscan_update_axis_positions always reads the step counters with :j, with the comment that the firmware corrects them from the encoders when on; synscan_read_encoder_position only feeds X_ENCODER_POSITION. 'about 0.34 deg' matches 360/1068 = 0.337 deg (AZ-GTi encoder count per revolution in code and PROPERTIES.md); 'at once' and the advice to sync again match the synscan_set_encoders comment and PROPERTIES.md ('re-bases the counter at once ... can shift the pointing until the next sync'). No contradiction found. README-only documentation change: no behaviour change, so no driver version bump, test run, PROPERTIES.md or Xcode project change is required (no file added). No defects.
